description: This Java class 'ShipmentServices' provides a collection of service methods for handling various shipment-related operations within the Apache OFBiz framework. The functionalities include creating and removing shipment estimates, calculating shipping costs, staging shipment data, updating shipment statuses, duplicating route segments, managing shipment notifications, and retrieving shipment gateway configurations. It interacts with the database entities such as Shipment, ShipmentPackage, ShipmentRouteSegment, and related entities, utilizing the OFBiz entity engine and service dispatching mechanisms to perform these operations.

classes.name: ShipmentServices
classes.description: Service class providing shipment management functionalities.

methods.name: createShipmentEstimate
methods.description: Creates a shipment cost estimate based on various shipping parameters and criteria.

methods.name: removeShipmentEstimate
methods.description: Removes a shipment cost estimate by its ID.

methods.name: calcShipmentCostEstimate
methods.description: Calculates the total shipping cost estimate given shipping details and estimates.

methods.name: fillShipmentStagingTables
methods.description: Fills staging tables with shipment data for further processing or external integrations.

methods.name: updateShipmentsFromStaging
methods.description: Updates shipment entities based on staged data, including weights and shipment status.

methods.name: clearShipmentStagingInfo
methods.description: Clears staging table data for a specific shipment.

methods.name: updatePurchaseShipmentFromReceipt
methods.description: Updates shipment status when receipts are generated, marking shipment as received if applicable.

methods.name: duplicateShipmentRouteSegment
methods.description: Duplicates an existing shipment route segment with optional modifications.

methods.name: quickScheduleShipmentRouteSegment
methods.description: Triggers asynchronous carrier-specific shipment confirmation and label generation.

methods.name: getShipmentPackageValueFromOrders
methods.description: Calculates the total value of a shipment package based on order items and invoiced amounts.

methods.name: sendShipmentCompleteNotification
methods.description: Sends email notification upon shipment completion, using configured email settings and templates.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigFromShipment
methods.description: Retrieves the shipment gateway configuration associated with a shipment, based on its store and route info.
